release_notes: Stable release of merged mwongj/VOD2MLIB PR #4. Manual and scheduled actions now use one current saved configuration. Save applies cron and timezone changes, with an Enable Auto-Rescan toggle for scheduled or manual-only use. Invalid enabled schedules are rejected before saving. Apply and Unschedule actions are removed. Existing schedules retain their enabled state; new installations default off. Plugin-owned save hooks implement scheduling without Dispatcharr source changes. Validation: 417 tests passed, 4 platform skips, including real Django/beat save, validation, toggle, upgrade, rollback, and queued-tick behavior. README and fork changelog reviewed against all 42 post-fork commits; install links, current behavior, inventory/performance, telemetry, scheduling and contributor instructions updated.
